summary: Unexpected 'Audit Log Export' line item on enterprise invoice for Neptune Labs
description:
Issue summary: Customer Neptune Labs (enterprise) received their March invoice with an unexpected line item labeled 'Audit Log Export (3/01/2026) - 1.2 GB' charged at $250. Neptune says audit-log exports are included in their negotiated enterprise package and have never been billed before.
Impact: Customer is disputing $250 on a finalized invoice and is concerned the charge represents a change in entitlements post-merge. This blocks autopay and escalates to finance.
Steps observed: Invoice INV-2026-03-01-NEP contains charge id CHG-88921. Export occurred the same day via Console > Audit > Export. Customer says the export was triggered by their third-party analytics team and should not be billable under their contract.
Expected: No separate 'audit log export' line item should appear for enterprise accounts with export entitlement.
Actual: Line item present and invoice finalized. Customer requests refund/credit and confirmation that future exports won't be billed.
steps_to_reproduce: Log in to Redwood Console as enterprise admin for Neptune Labs
Navigate to Audit -> Exports and trigger a CSV export for last 90 days (~1.2 GB payload)
Wait for background processing to finish (export status: ready)
Inspect generated invoice line in Billing -> Invoices for March billing run
logs: Line: CHG-88921: Audit Log Export (3/01/2026) - 1.2 GB - $250
Export event: export_id=exp-0a1b2c timestamp=2026-03-01T14:12:03Z user=analytics@neptune.example.com via console
Postback: billing-service recorded event export.complete -> tag: export_size_gb=1.2 entitlement_checked=false
comments: Customer (Neptune Labs) 2026-03-05: 'We never agreed to pay for audit exports; please reverse the $250 and confirm why this was billed.'
Support (Sofia) 2026-03-05: Acknowledged; opening investigation with Billing and Entitlements. Asking for the invoice PDF and company contract id.

Billing (internal) 2026-03-06: Saw CHG-88921. billing-service shows price lookup used SKU export_standard. Entitlement check returned false in the biller during run. Possible feature flag gap post-org-merge.

Entitlements (internal) 2026-03-07: Contract mapping for Neptune (contract:NPL-ENT-2024) present in partner-db. export_entitlement=true in contract, but billing-service call used org_alias 'neptune-legacy' which maps to different token. Hypothesis: org alias rename during migration caused entitlement mapping lookup to fail in nightly billing job.

Support (Ethan) 2026-03-09: Requested/attached signed contract page: 'Audit export included' and runbook to reproduce. Told customer provisional credit will be issued pending verification. Asked Finance to hold autopay for this invoice.
investigation_notes: Checked billing logs for billing-run-2026-03-01: export events were ingested, pricing lookup pipeline executed price_for(SKU=export_standard) -> $250; entitlement_check() call returned 'missing' for org_alias 'neptune-legacy' at 2026-03-01T23:45:01Z
Confirmed contract NPL-ENT-2024 contains clause 'Audit log exports up to 5 GB / month included' signed 2024-11-20.

Found a migration event on 2026-02-28 where org_alias was renamed from 'neptune-legacy' -> 'neptune'. Migration script updated partner-db but a small set of billing caches (cache shard 7) did not receive the alias mapping before billing job ran, causing entitlement lookup to fall back to default (false).
Replayed entitlement lookup for CHG-88921 with correct alias returns true (no charge).
No evidence customer-triggered export exceeded included free limits; size 1.2 GB within contracted 5 GB/month.
Finance: Tentative refund path approved if entitlement error confirmed; requires audit trail and signed contract copy attached to invoice for reversal.
planned_next_steps: 1) Issue provisional credit for $250 and annotate invoice INV-2026-03-01-NEP with support note
2) Patch billing cache invalidation to ensure alias mapping is present before nightly runs (billing team)
3) Run a targeted re-bill for Neptune for March cycle after patch and confirm final invoice matches contract
4) Notify customer and close once credit is posted and re-bill completed
resolution_notes: Provisional credit requested from Finance; awaiting credit application. Engineering to schedule cache invalidation hotfix in staging then prod. No final resolution yet.
